question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH regional_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM regional_sales
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    sku_name AS 销量最高单品
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    GROUP BY s.sku_id
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales
)
SELECT 
    bs.sku_id AS 品牌,
    bs.brand_net_amount / ts.total_net_amount AS 净销额占比
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.brand_net_amount / ts.total_net_amount > 0.10
ORDER BY 净销额占比 DESC

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数
FROM (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT AVG(终端净销额)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) AS 终端净销额
            FROM fact_sales s2
            JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
            GROUP BY s2.outlet_id
        ) t
    )
) sub

question: 每个品类销量最高的三个单品
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.category, p.sku_name
)
SELECT category AS 品类, sku_name AS 单品, 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY category, 销量 DESC

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.sku_id,
    d.year_month,
    SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
  GROUP BY s.sku_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
  a.sku_id AS 品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b 
  ON a.sku_id = b.sku_id 
  AND a.year_month = '2026-08' 
  AND b.year_month = '2026-07'
WHERE a.total_qty > b.total_qty

      AND d.year_month = '2026-08'
),
-- 华东区2026年8月已铺货组合数（动销率分母）
listed_combos AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_cnt
    FROM rel_outlet_sku r
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON r.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON r.listed_date <= d.full_date AND (r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date > d.full_date)
    WHERE o.region = '华东'
      AND o.is_active = TRUE
      AND d.year_month = '2026-08'
),
-- 华东区2026年8月动销组合数（动销率分子）
sold_combos AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (s.outlet_id, s.sku_id)) AS sold_combo_cnt
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE o.region = '华东'
      AND o.is_active = TRUE
      AND d.year_month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT listed_outlet_cnt FROM listed_outlets)::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF((SELECT outlet_cnt FROM target_outlets), 0) AS 铺市率,
    (SELECT sold_combo_cnt FROM sold_combos)::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF((SELECT combo_cnt FROM listed_combos), 0) AS 动销率

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS sales_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        mi.dealer_id,
        mi.total_on_hand,
        COALESCE(ms.total_qty, 0) AS total_qty,
        COALESCE(ms.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days
    FROM monthly_inventory mi
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
)
SELECT 
    c.dealer_id,
    c.total_on_hand / NULLIF(c.total_qty / NULLIF(c.sales_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM combined c
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH 本月 AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region AS 大区,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS 本月净销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
),
去年 AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region AS 大区,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS 去年净销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(m.大区, l.大区) AS 大区,
    (m.本月净销额 - l.去年净销额) / NULLIF(l.去年净销额, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM 本月 m
FULL JOIN 去年 l ON m.大区 = l.大区
ORDER BY 大区

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_month AS (
    SELECT 
        s.outlet_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-08', '2025-08')
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id, d.year_month
),
outlet_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        year_month,
        SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT outlet_id) AS outlet_count
    FROM current_month
    GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT 
    '2026-08' AS 月份,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2026-08' THEN total_net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2026-08' THEN outlet_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 本期单店产出,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2025-08' THEN total_net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2025-08' THEN outlet_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 去年同期单店产出,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2026-08' THEN total_net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2026-08' THEN outlet_count ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2025-08' THEN total_net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2025-08' THEN outlet_count ELSE 0 END), 0)) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2025-08' THEN total_net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_month = '2025-08' THEN outlet_count ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) AS 同比变化率
FROM outlet_sales

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS 费效比,
         CASE WHEN s.year_month >= '2026-01' THEN '2026H1' ELSE '2025H2' END AS period
  FROM s JOIN c USING (year_month)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN 费效比 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN 费效比 END) AS 费效比差值
FROM combined
